description: This 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for several large language models across different reasoning strategies. The horizontal axis represents the model type, with categories labeled “BARD”, “ChatGPT”, “Davinci-003”, and “Mix”, arranged alphabetically. The depth axis represents the reasoning strategy, with categories labeled “Abductive”, “Deductive”, and “Inductive”, also arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each bar represents the accuracy score for a specific model and reasoning strategy combination, with color gradients indicating the accuracy value; the bars range in height from approximately 0.15 to 0.75. The shortest bar, representing “ChatGPT” with “Inductive” reasoning, is colored light blue and has a height of approximately 0.15, while the tallest bar, representing “Davinci-003” with “Deductive” reasoning, is colored dark yellow and has a height of approximately 0.75. The bars are arranged in a grid pattern corresponding to the combinations of model and reasoning strategy, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
